hero.title: Don't buy. Just bilim.
hero.body: Rent the appliances you need while you live in Korea. When you leave, bilim buys your used ones.

about.title: About bilim
about.intro: bilim is a circular appliance rental platform for foreigners living in Korea. Appliances from people who leave go on to people who arrive.

cycle.title: How the bilim cycle works
cycle.caption: Appliances move from suppliers through bilim to rental customers, and repair partners keep the quality up.

pickup.title: Pickup service
pickup.body: Pickup is free when you sell to us and when a rental ends. We visit to fit your departure date.

grade.title: Prices by grade
grade.body: Every appliance gets a quality grade, and the rental price follows the grade. Choose what fits your budget.

multilingual.title: Multilingual support
multilingual.body: The site and our consultations are available in Korean, English and Chinese.

repair.title: Repair and inspection
repair.body: Appliances we buy are cleaned, inspected and repaired by specialists. Report any fault during your rental too.

1.q: Is there a minimum rental period?
1.a: The minimum period differs by product and package. You can check it under Rental terms on each product page.

2.q: How long do delivery and installation take?
2.a: We confirm the date in consultation, based on the schedule you requested. You can see the confirmed date on the My request page.

3.q: Can I cancel or extend during my rental?
3.a: Tell us through the messages on the My request page or a 1:1 inquiry, and we will guide you in consultation.

1.a: We buy refrigerators, washers, microwaves, air conditioners, TVs, vacuums, rice cookers and more. Very old or badly broken items may be hard to buy.

2.a: No. Pickup is free for appliances we buy.

3.q: How is the buyback price decided?
3.a: We give an estimate based on type, purchase year and condition. The final amount is set after inspection.

1.q: How do I pay the rental fee?
1.a: We explain the payment method during consultation.

2.q: When do I get my deposit back?
2.a: We return it after the rental ends and we have collected and checked the product.

1.q: What if something breaks during my rental?
1.a: Describe the problem through the messages on the My request page or a 1:1 inquiry. We will arrange an inspection by a repair partner.

2.a: It depends on whether the fault happened in normal use. We explain the details in consultation.

1.a: We help in Korean, English and Chinese. Choose KakaoTalk, WeChat, WhatsApp or email, whichever is easiest.

2.a: The service area is being prepared. When you apply, we check your address and tell you whether we can serve it.
